This report asks whether the same properties near mapped sewage overflows
experienced different price changes from farther properties as national sewage
attention increased. It extends the extensive-margin news analysis with
repeat-property panels: property fixed effects replace location fixed effects,
so the near–far gap is identified from within-property price changes across
calendar months. Sales cover January 2014 through December 2024; rentals cover
January 2014 through December 2023.

The report first establishes that the inputs are usable: mapping integrity,
current-address consistency of the repeat mappings, an ordered sample contract
with an exclusion ledger, and observation diagnostics. Estimation, attention
measures and the coefficient comparisons follow in later sections.

**This rendering:** `r if (params$reestimate) "inputs re-validated and analyses re-estimated from the published inputs." else "results loaded from the saved bundle in output/regs."`

```{r}
#| label: helpers-inputs
#| include: false

`%chin%` <- data.table::`%chin%`

# ---- Market configuration ------------------------------------------------------

market_config <- function(market) {
  if (!is.character(market) || length(market) != 1L || !market %in% MARKETS) {
    stop("Unknown market: ", paste(market, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  cfg <- CONFIG[[market]]
  cfg$market <- market
  cfg
}

# The list shape that build_address_key()/validate_repeat_config() expect. Paths
# other than the input are placeholders: nothing is written and `publish` is unset.
repeat_key_config <- function(cfg) {
  list(
    id_col = cfg$id_col, date_col = cfg$date_col, price_col = cfg$price_col,
    postcode_col = "postcode", address_cols = cfg$address_cols,
    primary_address_col = cfg$primary_address_col,
    input_path = cfg$history_path,
    output_path = "read-only", log_file = "read-only",
    large_group_review_path = "read-only", price_ratio_review_path = "read-only",
    same_day_review_path = "read-only",
    market = cfg$market,
    year_min = lubridate::year(cfg$start), year_max = lubridate::year(cfg$end),
    key_coverage_floor = 0, repeat_share_floor = 0,
    large_group_size = CONFIG$large_group_size,
    extreme_annualized_price_ratio = CONFIG$extreme_annualized_price_ratio
  )
}

history_columns <- function(cfg) {
  extra <- if (cfg$market == "rentals") "rented" else character()
  unique(c(
    cfg$id_col, cfg$date_col, cfg$price_col, cfg$address_cols, cfg$change_cols,
    cfg$control_cols, "country", "easting", "northing", "lsoa", "msoa", "quality", extra
  ))
}

mapping_columns <- function(cfg) c(cfg$id_col, "repeat_id", "repeat_count")

review_path <- function(cfg, suffix) {
  sub("\\.parquet$", paste0("_", suffix, ".parquet"), cfg$mapping_path)
}

# ---- Blocking conditions -------------------------------------------------------

# A validation failure that the plan says should stop the affected market, not
# the whole run. prepare_market_panel() catches this class and records the market
# as blocked with `details`; any other error propagates and stops the render.
block_market <- function(market, stage, message, details = NULL) {
  cond <- structure(
    class = c("market_blocked", "error", "condition"),
    list(
      message = sprintf("[%s / %s] %s", market, stage, message), call = NULL,
      market = market, stage = stage, details = details
    )
  )
  stop(cond)
}

# ---- Input readability and provenance -----------------------------------------

assert_readable_input <- function(path, label, market = NA_character_) {
  fail <- function(msg) {
    if (is.na(market)) stop(msg, call. = FALSE)
    block_market(market, "input", msg)
  }
  if (!is.character(path) || length(path) != 1L || is.na(path) || !file.exists(path)) {
    fail(sprintf("Required input `%s` is unreadable: file not found at %s", label, path))
  }
  reader <- tryCatch(
    arrow::ParquetFileReader$create(path),
    error = function(e) fail(sprintf(
      "Required input `%s` is unreadable: %s (%s)", label, path, conditionMessage(e)
    ))
  )
  invisible(reader)
}

parquet_file_info <- function(path, label, market = NA_character_) {
  reader <- assert_readable_input(path, label, market)
  schema <- reader$GetSchema()
  list(n_rows = as.numeric(reader$num_rows), columns = names(schema), metadata = schema$metadata)
}

generation_id_from_metadata <- function(metadata) {
  candidates <- c("cleaning_run_stamp", "run_timestamp")
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% names(metadata)]
  if (length(hit) == 0L) return(NA_character_)
  as.character(metadata[[hit[[1L]]]])
}

# Content identity is the file hash; mtime/size are descriptive only (KTD8).
capture_input_provenance <- function(input, path, columns_used, market = NA_character_) {
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, input, market)
  tibble::tibble(
    input = input,
    path = path,
    content_hash = digest::digest(file = path, algo = "xxhash64"),
    generation_id = generation_id_from_metadata(info$metadata),
    n_rows = info$n_rows,
    columns_used = paste(columns_used, collapse = ";"),
    mtime = format(file.info(path)$mtime, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", tz = "UTC")
  )
}

# ---- Loading (column-pruned; read_parquet -> as.data.frame -> as.data.table) -----

read_parquet_columns <- function(path, columns) {
  arrow::read_parquet(path, col_select = tidyselect::all_of(columns)) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    data.table::as.data.table()
}

load_history <- function(market, path = market_config(market)$history_path,
                         cfg = market_config(market)) {
  cols <- history_columns(cfg)
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, paste0(market, "_history"), market)
  missing <- setdiff(cols, info$columns)
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    block_market(market, "input", sprintf(
      "history %s lacks required columns: %s", path, paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  dt <- read_parquet_columns(path, cols)
  dt[, (cfg$id_col) := as.character(get(cfg$id_col))]
  dt[, (cfg$date_col) := as_transaction_date(get(cfg$date_col))]
  dt[, (cfg$price_col) := as.numeric(get(cfg$price_col))]
  dt[, easting := as.numeric(easting)]
  dt[, northing := as.numeric(northing)]
  dt[, quality := as.integer(quality)]
  for (col in c("country", "lsoa", "msoa")) dt[, (col) := as.character(get(col))]
  dt[]
}

load_mapping <- function(market, path = market_config(market)$mapping_path,
                         cfg = market_config(market)) {
  cols <- mapping_columns(cfg)
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, paste0(market, "_mapping"), market)
  missing <- setdiff(cols, info$columns)
  if (length(missing) > 0L) {
    block_market(market, "input", sprintf(
      "mapping %s lacks required columns: %s", path, paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
  dt <- read_parquet_columns(path, cols)
  dt[, (cfg$id_col) := as.character(get(cfg$id_col))]
  dt[, repeat_id := as.character(repeat_id)]
  dt[, repeat_count := as.integer(repeat_count)]
  list(mapping = dt[], manifest = info$metadata)
}

load_same_day_ids <- function(market, cfg = market_config(market)) {
  path <- review_path(cfg, "same_day")
  info <- parquet_file_info(path, paste0(market, "_same_day_review"), market)
  if (!cfg$id_col %in% info$columns) {
    block_market(market, "input", sprintf("same-day review %s lacks %s", path, cfg$id_col))
  }
  if (info$n_rows == 0) return(character())
  as.character(read_parquet_columns(path, cfg$id_col)[[cfg$id_col]])
}

# ---- Mapping validation (KTD10, structural part) -------------------------------

validate_mapping <- function(history, mapping, manifest, same_day_ids, market,
                             cfg = market_config(market)) {
  id_col <- cfg$id_col
  fail <- function(message, details = NULL) block_market(market, "mapping", message, details)

  hist_ids <- history[[id_col]]
  map_ids <- mapping[[id_col]]
  if (!is.character(hist_ids) || anyNA(hist_ids) || any(!nzchar(hist_ids))) {
    fail("history transaction ids must be non-missing character strings")
  }
  n_hist_dup <- sum(duplicated(hist_ids))
  if (n_hist_dup > 0L) fail(sprintf("history contains %d duplicated transaction ids", n_hist_dup))
  if (!is.character(map_ids) || anyNA(map_ids) || any(!nzchar(map_ids))) {
    fail("mapping transaction ids must be non-missing character strings")
  }
  n_map_dup <- sum(duplicated(map_ids))
  if (n_map_dup > 0L) {
    fail(sprintf("mapping contains %d duplicated transaction ids; a join would multiply rows", n_map_dup),
         details = list(n_duplicated_mapping_ids = n_map_dup))
  }
  if (!is.character(mapping$repeat_id) || anyNA(mapping$repeat_id) ||
      any(!grepl("^[0-9a-f]{16}$", mapping$repeat_id))) {
    fail("mapping repeat_id values must be 16-character lowercase hex strings")
  }

  map_in_hist <- map_ids %chin% hist_ids
  n_absent_from_history <- sum(!map_in_hist)
  if (n_absent_from_history > 0L) {
    fail(sprintf("mapping contains %d ids absent from history", n_absent_from_history),
         details = list(n_mapping_absent_from_history = n_absent_from_history))
  }

  required_fields <- c("repeat_manifest_version", "input_row_count", "mapped_count",
                       "excluded_count", "same_day_excluded_count", "run_timestamp")
  missing_fields <- setdiff(required_fields, names(manifest))
  if (length(missing_fields) > 0L) {
    fail(paste("mapping manifest lacks fields:", paste(missing_fields, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  manifest_num <- function(field) as.numeric(manifest[[field]])
  if (manifest_num("input_row_count") != nrow(history)) {
    fail(sprintf("manifest input_row_count %s differs from history rows %d",
                 manifest$input_row_count, nrow(history)))
  }
  if (manifest_num("mapped_count") != nrow(mapping)) {
    fail(sprintf("manifest mapped_count %s differs from mapping rows %d",
                 manifest$mapped_count, nrow(mapping)))
  }

  # History rows absent from the mapping must be exactly the unkeyed addresses
  # plus the same-day conflicts. Recompute the key on those rows only (cheap) and
  # compare with the manifest counts and the same-day review ids.
  hist_in_map <- hist_ids %chin% map_ids
  absent_ids <- hist_ids[!hist_in_map]
  n_absent <- length(absent_ids)
  same_day_ids <- unique(as.character(same_day_ids))
  absent_keys <- if (n_absent > 0L) {
    build_address_key(history[!hist_in_map, cfg$address_cols, with = FALSE], repeat_key_config(cfg))
  } else {
    character()
  }
  n_unkeyed_recomputed <- sum(is.na(absent_keys))
  keyed_absent_ids <- absent_ids[!is.na(absent_keys)]
  n_same_day_not_absent <- sum(!same_day_ids %chin% absent_ids)
  reconciled <- n_absent == manifest_num("excluded_count") + manifest_num("same_day_excluded_count") &&
    n_unkeyed_recomputed == manifest_num("excluded_count") &&
    length(same_day_ids) == manifest_num("same_day_excluded_count") &&
    n_same_day_not_absent == 0L &&
    setequal(keyed_absent_ids, same_day_ids)

  result <- list(
    status = if (reconciled) "passed" else "failed",
    n_history = nrow(history),
    n_mapping = nrow(mapping),
    n_groups_mapping = data.table::uniqueN(mapping$repeat_id),
    n_mapping_absent_from_history = n_absent_from_history,
    n_history_absent_from_mapping = n_absent,
    n_unkeyed_manifest = manifest_num("excluded_count"),
    n_unkeyed_recomputed = n_unkeyed_recomputed,
    n_same_day_manifest = manifest_num("same_day_excluded_count"),
    n_same_day_review = length(same_day_ids),
    n_same_day_recomputed = length(keyed_absent_ids),
    n_same_day_not_absent = n_same_day_not_absent,
    reconciled = reconciled,
    manifest_version = as.character(manifest$repeat_manifest_version),
    generation_id = as.character(manifest$run_timestamp),
    manifest_input_mtime = as.character(manifest$input_mtime %||% NA_character_),
    manifest_largest_group_size = as.character(manifest$largest_group_size %||% NA_character_)
  )
  if (!reconciled) {
    fail(sprintf(
      paste("history rows absent from mapping (%d) do not reconcile with manifest unkeyed (%s) +",
            "same-day (%s); recomputed unkeyed %d, same-day review ids %d (%d not absent)"),
      n_absent, manifest$excluded_count, manifest$same_day_excluded_count,
      n_unkeyed_recomputed, length(same_day_ids), n_same_day_not_absent
    ), details = result)
  }
  result
}

# ---- Current-address verification (KTD10, read-only) ----------------------------

# `candidates` holds the id column plus the market's address columns for every
# requested-window row that is in the mapping, singles included. Keys and
# expected repeat ids are recomputed with the production contract and compared
# with the stored repeat_id. Nothing is rebuilt or repaired.
verify_current_address_keys <- function(candidates, mapping, market, cfg = market_config(market)) {
  id_col <- cfg$id_col
  idx <- match(candidates[[id_col]], mapping[[id_col]])
  if (anyNA(idx)) {
    stop("verify_current_address_keys() received rows absent from the mapping.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  stored <- mapping$repeat_id[idx]
  key <- build_address_key(candidates[, cfg$address_cols, with = FALSE], repeat_key_config(cfg))
  missing_key <- is.na(key)
  expected <- rep(NA_character_, length(key))
  if (any(!missing_key)) expected[!missing_key] <- hash_serialized_values(key[!missing_key])
  mismatched <- !missing_key & expected != stored
  group_sizes <- data.table::data.table(repeat_id = stored)[, .N, by = repeat_id]
  result <- list(
    status = if (any(missing_key) || any(mismatched)) "failed" else "passed",
    n_candidates = length(key),
    n_candidate_groups = nrow(group_sizes),
    n_window_singles = sum(group_sizes$N == 1L),
    n_missing_keys = sum(missing_key),
    n_mismatched = sum(mismatched),
    n_mismatched_groups = data.table::uniqueN(stored[mismatched]),
    example_missing_ids = utils::head(candidates[[id_col]][missing_key], 5L),
    example_mismatched_ids = utils::head(candidates[[id_col]][mismatched], 5L)
  )
  if (result$status != "passed") {
    block_market(market, "address_keys", sprintf(
      paste("current address keys disagree with the stored mapping: %d candidates,",
            "%d missing current keys, %d mismatched repeat ids (%d groups);",
            "mapping is stale relative to the history and must be regenerated upstream"),
      result$n_candidates, result$n_missing_keys, result$n_mismatched, result$n_mismatched_groups
    ), details = result)
  }
  result
}

# ---- Geography contradictions within candidate groups ---------------------------

# Contradiction = more than one distinct NONMISSING value within a repeat group.
# Missing-to-observed differences are not contradictions.
check_group_geography_contradictions <- function(candidates) {
  needed <- c("repeat_id", "country", "easting", "northing", "lsoa", "msoa")
  missing <- setdiff(needed, names(candidates))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) stop("Geography check lacks columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  distinct_nonmissing <- function(cols) {
    dt <- candidates[, c("repeat_id", cols), with = FALSE]
    keep <- Reduce(`&`, lapply(cols, function(col) !is.na(dt[[col]])))
    unique(dt[keep])[, .N, by = repeat_id][N > 1L, repeat_id]
  }
  country_ids <- distinct_nonmissing("country")
  coord_ids <- distinct_nonmissing(c("easting", "northing"))
  lsoa_ids <- distinct_nonmissing("lsoa")
  msoa_ids <- distinct_nonmissing("msoa")
  group_ids <- unique(c(country_ids, coord_ids, lsoa_ids, msoa_ids))
  list(
    n_groups_checked = data.table::uniqueN(candidates$repeat_id),
    n_rows_checked = nrow(candidates),
    n_groups_contradictory = length(group_ids),
    n_groups_country = length(country_ids),
    n_groups_coordinates = length(coord_ids),
    n_groups_lsoa = length(lsoa_ids),
    n_groups_msoa = length(msoa_ids),
    group_ids = group_ids
  )
}

# ---- Exclusion ledger ----------------------------------------------------------

count_groups <- function(repeat_ids) data.table::uniqueN(repeat_ids[!is.na(repeat_ids)])

new_ledger <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    market = character(), step_order = integer(), step = character(),
    n_rows_before = numeric(), n_rows_after = numeric(), n_rows_removed = numeric(),
    n_groups_before = numeric(), n_groups_after = numeric(), note = character()
  )
}

ledger_append <- function(ledger, market, step, n_rows_before, n_rows_after,
                          n_groups_before, n_groups_after, note = "") {
  dplyr::bind_rows(ledger, tibble::tibble(
    market = market, step_order = nrow(ledger) + 1L, step = step,
    n_rows_before = as.numeric(n_rows_before), n_rows_after = as.numeric(n_rows_after),
    n_rows_removed = as.numeric(n_rows_before) - as.numeric(n_rows_after),
    n_groups_before = as.numeric(n_groups_before), n_groups_after = as.numeric(n_groups_after),
    note = note
  ))
}

# Restrict a panel by a logical vector and append the ledger row (for U2/U3).
restrict_panel <- function(panel, keep, ledger, market, step, note = "") {
  if (length(keep) != nrow(panel)) stop("`keep` must have one entry per panel row.", call. = FALSE)
  keep <- !is.na(keep) & keep
  before_rows <- nrow(panel)
  before_groups <- count_groups(panel$repeat_id)
  panel <- panel[keep]
  ledger <- ledger_append(ledger, market, step, before_rows, nrow(panel),
                          before_groups, count_groups(panel$repeat_id), note)
  list(panel = panel, ledger = ledger)
}

assert_ledger_identity <- function(ledger) {
  for (mkt in unique(ledger$market)) {
    rows <- ledger[ledger$market == mkt, ]
    rows <- rows[order(rows$step_order), ]
    if (!all(rows$n_rows_removed == rows$n_rows_before - rows$n_rows_after)) {
      stop("Ledger removed counts do not equal before minus after for ", mkt, call. = FALSE)
    }
    if (nrow(rows) > 1L && !all(rows$n_rows_after[-nrow(rows)] == rows$n_rows_before[-1L])) {
      stop("Ledger rows do not chain for ", mkt, call. = FALSE)
    }
    if (nrow(rows) > 1L && !all(rows$n_groups_after[-nrow(rows)] == rows$n_groups_before[-1L])) {
      stop("Ledger group counts do not chain for ", mkt, call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}

# ---- Repeat eligibility and change flags -----------------------------------------

# Eligibility = at least two DISTINCT dates surviving in the group (AE1). Stored
# repeat_count is full-window and is never consulted.
repeat_eligible_ids <- function(panel) {
  distinct_dates <- unique(panel[, .(repeat_id, date)])[, .N, by = repeat_id]
  distinct_dates[N >= 2L, repeat_id]
}

recompute_repeats <- function(panel) {
  panel[repeat_id %chin% repeat_eligible_ids(panel)]
}

# One logical per change column: more than one distinct nonmissing value within
# the group. Missing-to-observed is never a change (AE2).
freeze_change_flags <- function(panel, change_cols) {
  missing <- setdiff(change_cols, names(panel))
  if (length(missing) > 0L) stop("Change columns absent from panel: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  flags <- data.table::data.table(repeat_id = unique(panel$repeat_id))
  for (col in change_cols) {
    changed_ids <- unique(panel[!is.na(get(col)), c("repeat_id", col), with = FALSE])[, .N, by = repeat_id][N > 1L, repeat_id]
    flags[, (paste0("change_", col)) := repeat_id %chin% changed_ids]
  }
  flag_cols <- paste0("change_", change_cols)
  flags[, any_change := Reduce(`|`, lapply(flag_cols, function(col) flags[[col]]))]
  flags[]
}

# ---- Requested coverage --------------------------------------------------------

assert_requested_years <- function(dates, market, cfg) {
  requested <- seq(lubridate::year(cfg$start), lubridate::year(cfg$end))
  if (length(dates) == 0L) {
    block_market(market, "coverage", sprintf(
      "no observations between %s and %s in %s", cfg$start, cfg$end, cfg$history_path
    ))
  }
  present <- unique(lubridate::year(dates))
  absent <- setdiff(requested, present)
  if (length(absent) > 0L) {
    block_market(market, "coverage", sprintf(
      "requested year(s) %s have no observations in %s",
      paste(absent, collapse = ", "), cfg$history_path
    ))
  }
  invisible(requested)
}

# ---- Rental unit evidence ------------------------------------------------------

# The local provider profile does not define the rental listing_price unit. A
# constant unit is absorbed by property and month effects; a unit break at the
# 2022/2023 vintage boundary would not be. No conversion is ever applied.
rental_unit_evidence <- function(prices, dates, repeat_ids, tolerance = CONFIG$rental_unit_tolerance) {
  dt <- data.table::data.table(price = prices, date = dates, repeat_id = repeat_ids)
  dt <- dt[is.finite(price) & price > 0]
  dt[, year := lubridate::year(date)]
  dt[, month := lubridate::floor_date(date, "month")]
  by_year <- dt[, .(
    n = .N, median = stats::median(price), q25 = stats::quantile(price, 0.25),
    q75 = stats::quantile(price, 0.75), log_mean = mean(log(price))
  ), by = year][order(year)]
  by_month <- dt[month >= as.Date("2022-07-01") & month <= as.Date("2023-06-01"), .(
    n = .N, median = stats::median(price), q25 = stats::quantile(price, 0.25),
    q75 = stats::quantile(price, 0.75), log_mean = mean(log(price))
  ), by = month][order(month)]
  median_2022 <- by_year[year == 2022L, median]
  median_2023 <- by_year[year == 2023L, median]
  ratio <- if (length(median_2022) == 1L && length(median_2023) == 1L) median_2023 / median_2022 else NA_real_
  # Within-property: properties listed in both 2022 and 2023.
  within <- dt[year %in% c(2022L, 2023L), .(log_mean = mean(log(price))), by = .(repeat_id, year)]
  within <- data.table::dcast(within, repeat_id ~ year, value.var = "log_mean")
  within_ratio <- if (all(c("2022", "2023") %in% names(within))) {
    both <- within[!is.na(`2022`) & !is.na(`2023`)]
    if (nrow(both) > 0L) exp(stats::median(both[["2023"]] - both[["2022"]])) else NA_real_
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }
  n_within <- if (all(c("2022", "2023") %in% names(within))) sum(!is.na(within$`2022`) & !is.na(within$`2023`)) else 0L
  weekly_monthly <- 52 / 12
  near_conversion <- function(r) {
    !is.na(r) && (abs(log(r) - log(weekly_monthly)) < log(tolerance) ||
                    abs(log(r) + log(weekly_monthly)) < log(tolerance))
  }
  status <- if (is.na(ratio)) {
    "blocked"
  } else if (near_conversion(ratio) || near_conversion(within_ratio)) {
    "blocked"
  } else {
    "consistent_within_property_comparable"
  }
  list(
    status = status,
    documented_unit = paste(
      "Not documented locally: data/raw/zoopla/CDRC Data Profile - WFZ Transactions Safeguarded",
      "20221124.pdf describes the sales-matched dataset, not the rentals file. Existing project",
      "tables label the outcome 'log weekly asking rent'."
    ),
    vintage_proxy = "listing year 2023 (rentals_safeguarded_2023.csv) vs 2014-2022 (rentals_safeguarded_2014-2022.csv); the processed file carries no vintage column",
    conversion_applied = "none",
    median_ratio_2023_2022 = ratio,
    within_property_ratio_2023_2022 = within_ratio,
    n_within_property_pairs = n_within,
    weekly_monthly_factor = weekly_monthly,
    tolerance = tolerance,
    by_year = tibble::as_tibble(by_year),
    by_month = tibble::as_tibble(by_month),
    reason = if (status == "blocked") {
      sprintf("2023/2022 median ratio %.3f (within-property %.3f) lies within the weekly/monthly conversion band",
              ratio, within_ratio)
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  )
}

# ---- Ordered sample contract -----------------------------------------------------

# Steps (plan order): requested dates -> mapped rows -> KTD10 address verification
# -> geography contradictions on candidate groups -> finite positive outcome ->
# England -> projected coordinates -> LSOA/MSOA. The panel is returned BEFORE the
# distance bands (U2) and the two-distinct-dates requirement (U2 applies bands,
# then calls recompute_repeats() through restrict_panel()).
# Restrictions are accumulated in one logical vector over the full history so no
# full-width copy is made until the narrow panel is built.
apply_sample_contract <- function(history, mapping, market, cfg = market_config(market)) {
  id_col <- cfg$id_col
  n_full <- nrow(history)
  ids <- history[[id_col]]
  repeat_id <- mapping$repeat_id[match(ids, mapping[[id_col]])]
  dates <- as_transaction_date(history[[cfg$date_col]])
  price <- history[[cfg$price_col]]
  ledger <- new_ledger()
  groups <- function(keep) count_groups(repeat_id[keep])
  step <- function(prev, keep, name, note) {
    ledger <<- ledger_append(ledger, market, name, sum(prev), sum(keep), groups(prev), groups(keep), note)
    keep
  }

  # (1) requested dates
  all_rows <- rep(TRUE, n_full)
  keep <- !is.na(dates) & dates >= cfg$start & dates <= cfg$end
  keep <- step(all_rows, keep, "requested_dates",
               sprintf("%s to %s inclusive", cfg$start, cfg$end))
  assert_requested_years(dates[keep], market, cfg)
  coverage <- data.table::data.table(year = lubridate::year(dates[keep]))[, .(n_rows = .N), by = year][order(year)]
  coverage <- tibble::tibble(market = market, year = coverage$year, n_rows = coverage$n_rows)
  date_range <- range(dates[keep])

  # (2) rows in the mapping (unkeyed addresses and same-day conflicts are absent;
  #     they were reconciled in validate_mapping())
  keep <- step(keep, keep & !is.na(repeat_id), "mapped_rows",
               "rows absent from the repeat mapping: unkeyed addresses and same-day conflicts")

  # (2b) KTD10 read-only address verification on all mapped window candidates
  address <- verify_current_address_keys(
    history[keep, c(id_col, cfg$address_cols), with = FALSE], mapping, market, cfg
  )
  keep <- step(keep, keep, "address_key_verification",
               sprintf("read-only recomputation of address keys and repeat ids on %d candidates (%d singles); no rows removed",
                       address$n_candidates, address$n_window_singles))

  # (3) contradictory nonmissing geography within candidate groups
  geography <- check_group_geography_contradictions(data.table::data.table(
    repeat_id = repeat_id[keep], country = history$country[keep],
    easting = history$easting[keep], northing = history$northing[keep],
    lsoa = history$lsoa[keep], msoa = history$msoa[keep]
  ))
  keep <- step(keep, keep & !(repeat_id %chin% geography$group_ids), "geography_contradictions",
               sprintf("whole groups with >1 distinct nonmissing country (%d), coordinates (%d), LSOA (%d) or MSOA (%d)",
                       geography$n_groups_country, geography$n_groups_coordinates,
                       geography$n_groups_lsoa, geography$n_groups_msoa))

  # (4) common requirements
  keep <- step(keep, keep & is.finite(price) & price > 0, "finite_positive_outcome",
               sprintf("finite positive %s; outcome is log(%s)", cfg$price_col, cfg$price_col))
  unit_evidence <- if (market == "rentals") {
    rental_unit_evidence(price[keep], dates[keep], repeat_id[keep])
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  keep <- step(keep, keep & !is.na(history$country) & history$country == "England", "england",
               "country == England (Greater London retained; Wales, Scotland and missing country dropped)")
  keep <- step(keep, keep & is.finite(history$easting) & is.finite(history$northing), "projected_coordinates",
               "nonmissing British National Grid easting and northing")
  keep <- step(keep, keep & !is.na(history$lsoa) & nzchar(history$lsoa) & !is.na(history$msoa) & nzchar(history$msoa),
               "lsoa_msoa_nonmissing", "nonmissing 2011 LSOA and MSOA identifiers")

  # Narrow panel built by column extraction (safe pattern for later data.table keys).
  panel_dates <- dates[keep]
  panel <- data.table::data.table(
    id = ids[keep],
    repeat_id = repeat_id[keep],
    date = panel_dates,
    year = as.integer(lubridate::year(panel_dates)),
    month_index = as.integer((lubridate::year(panel_dates) - lubridate::year(CONFIG$article_origin)) * 12L +
                               lubridate::month(panel_dates) - lubridate::month(CONFIG$article_origin) + 1L),
    log_price = log(price[keep]),
    lsoa = history$lsoa[keep],
    msoa = history$msoa[keep],
    easting = history$easting[keep],
    northing = history$northing[keep],
    postcode = as.character(history$postcode[keep]),
    quality = history$quality[keep]
  )
  for (col in unique(c(cfg$change_cols, cfg$control_cols))) panel[, (col) := history[[col]][keep]]
  if (market == "rentals") panel[, rented_fallback := is.na(history$rented[keep])]

  list(
    panel = panel[],
    ledger = ledger,
    coverage = coverage,
    date_range = date_range,
    address_verification = address,
    geography = geography[setdiff(names(geography), "group_ids")],
    unit_evidence = unit_evidence
  )
}

# ---- Observation diagnostics (no exclusions) ------------------------------------

compute_observation_diagnostics <- function(panel, market, group_col = NULL,
                                            cfg = market_config(market)) {
  grp <- if (is.null(group_col)) character() else group_col
  if (length(grp) > 0L && !all(grp %in% names(panel))) {
    stop("Grouping column(s) absent from panel: ", paste(setdiff(grp, names(panel)), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  dt <- panel[, c("id", "repeat_id", "date", "year", "log_price", "easting", "northing",
                  "postcode", "quality", intersect(c("rented_fallback"), names(panel)), grp), with = FALSE]
  data.table::setorderv(dt, c("repeat_id", "date", "id"))

  # Observations per repeat group (a group sits in one band because location is fixed).
  per_group <- dt[, .(n_obs = .N), by = c("repeat_id", grp)]
  per_group[, size_bucket := data.table::fcase(
    n_obs == 1L, "1", n_obs == 2L, "2", n_obs == 3L, "3", n_obs == 4L, "4",
    n_obs <= 8L, "5-8", n_obs <= CONFIG$large_group_size, "9-12",
    default = paste0(">", CONFIG$large_group_size)
  )]
  group_sizes <- per_group[, .(n_groups = .N, n_rows = sum(n_obs)), by = c(grp, "size_bucket")]
  data.table::setorderv(group_sizes, c(grp, "size_bucket"))
  n_large_groups <- sum(per_group$n_obs > CONFIG$large_group_size)

  # Inter-observation gaps and same-month repeats (consecutive pairs within a group).
  dt[, prev_date := data.table::shift(date), by = repeat_id]
  dt[, prev_log_price := data.table::shift(log_price), by = repeat_id]
  dt[, gap_days := as.numeric(date - prev_date)]
  pairs <- dt[!is.na(gap_days)]
  gap_summary <- pairs[, .(
    n_pairs = .N,
    min = min(gap_days), p10 = stats::quantile(gap_days, 0.10), p25 = stats::quantile(gap_days, 0.25),
    median = stats::median(gap_days), p75 = stats::quantile(gap_days, 0.75),
    p90 = stats::quantile(gap_days, 0.90), max = max(gap_days),
    share_under_30_days = mean(gap_days < 30),
    share_under_365_days = mean(gap_days < 365)
  ), by = grp]
  pairs[, same_month := lubridate::year(date) == lubridate::year(prev_date) &
          lubridate::month(date) == lubridate::month(prev_date)]
  same_month <- pairs[, .(
    n_pairs = .N, n_same_month_pairs = sum(same_month), share_same_month_pairs = mean(same_month),
    n_groups_with_same_month_pair = data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id[same_month]),
    share_groups_with_same_month_pair = data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id[same_month]) / data.table::uniqueN(repeat_id)
  ), by = grp]

  # Outcome summaries by year (and optional grouping).
  outcome_by_year <- dt[, .(
    n = .N, mean_log = mean(log_price), sd_log = stats::sd(log_price),
    p10 = stats::quantile(log_price, 0.10), median = stats::median(log_price),
    p90 = stats::quantile(log_price, 0.90)
  ), by = c(grp, "year")]
  data.table::setorderv(outcome_by_year, c(grp, "year"))

  # Extreme annualised price ratios (descriptive flag; same definition as the
  # repeat-transaction review: ratio^(365.25/holding_days) > 4 or < 1/4).
  threshold <- CONFIG$extreme_annualized_price_ratio
  pairs[, annualized_ratio := data.table::fifelse(
    gap_days > 0, exp(log_price - prev_log_price)^(365.25 / gap_days), NA_real_
  )]
  pairs[, extreme := !is.na(annualized_ratio) & (annualized_ratio > threshold | annualized_ratio < 1 / threshold)]
  extreme_by_year <- pairs[, .(n_pairs = .N, n_extreme = sum(extreme), share_extreme = mean(extreme)),
                           by = c(grp, "year")]
  data.table::setorderv(extreme_by_year, c(grp, "year"))
  extreme_total <- pairs[, .(n_pairs = .N, n_extreme = sum(extreme), share_extreme = mean(extreme)), by = grp]

  # Rental rented_est fallback (rented missing, latest_to_rent used) by year.
  fallback_by_year <- if ("rented_fallback" %in% names(dt)) {
    out <- dt[, .(n = .N, n_fallback = sum(rented_fallback), share_fallback = mean(rented_fallback)), by = c(grp, "year")]
    data.table::setorderv(out, c(grp, "year"))
    tibble::as_tibble(out)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  # Spatial precision: unique coordinates versus properties; coordinate quality.
  spatial <- list(
    n_rows = nrow(dt),
    n_properties = data.table::uniqueN(dt$repeat_id),
    n_unique_coordinates = nrow(unique(dt[, .(easting, northing)])),
    n_unique_postcodes = data.table::uniqueN(dt$postcode),
    quality_distribution = tibble::as_tibble(dt[, .(n_rows = .N), by = quality][order(quality)]),
    geography_vintage = "2011 LSOA/MSOA codes from the ONS postcode lookup used at cleaning",
    postcode_lookup_path = CONFIG$postcode_lookup_path,
    postcode_lookup_exists = file.exists(CONFIG$postcode_lookup_path)
  )

  list(
    market = market,
    group_col = group_col,
    n_rows = nrow(dt),
    n_groups = data.table::uniqueN(dt$repeat_id),
    n_large_groups = n_large_groups,
    group_sizes = tibble::as_tibble(group_sizes),
    gap_summary = tibble::as_tibble(gap_summary),
    same_month = tibble::as_tibble(same_month),
    outcome_by_year = tibble::as_tibble(outcome_by_year),
    extreme_ratio_total = tibble::as_tibble(extreme_total),
    extreme_ratio_by_year = tibble::as_tibble(extreme_by_year),
    rented_fallback_by_year = fallback_by_year,
    spatial = spatial
  )
}

# ---- Market preparation (provenance -> load -> validate -> contract -> diagnostics)

# Returns list(market, status, reason, panel, readiness, ledger, diagnostics,
# provenance). `panel` is the pre-band panel (NULL when blocked). Later units
# call this inside the per-market estimate loop, then apply bands,
# recompute_repeats() and freeze_change_flags().
prepare_market_panel <- function(market, cfg = market_config(market)) {
  started <- Sys.time()
  invisible(gc(reset = TRUE))
  readiness <- list(market = market, status = "ready", reason = NA_character_, blocked_stage = NA_character_)
  out <- list(market = market, status = "ready", reason = NA_character_, panel = NULL,
              readiness = readiness, ledger = new_ledger(), diagnostics = NULL,
              provenance = tibble::tibble())
  result <- tryCatch({
    provenance <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      capture_input_provenance(paste0(market, "_history"), cfg$history_path, history_columns(cfg), market),
      capture_input_provenance(paste0(market, "_mapping"), cfg$mapping_path, mapping_columns(cfg), market),
      capture_input_provenance(paste0(market, "_same_day_review"), review_path(cfg, "same_day"), cfg$id_col, market)
    )
    history <- load_history(market, cfg$history_path, cfg)
    mapping_obj <- load_mapping(market, cfg$mapping_path, cfg)
    same_day_ids <- load_same_day_ids(market, cfg)
    mapping_validation <- validate_mapping(history, mapping_obj$mapping, mapping_obj$manifest,
                                           same_day_ids, market, cfg)
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping_obj$mapping, market, cfg)
    rm(history, mapping_obj, same_day_ids)
    invisible(gc())
    # Diagnostics on the pre-band panel restricted to >= 2 distinct dates. This is
    # informational only; the ledger's two-distinct-dates step is applied after
    # the bands (U2).
    eligible <- recompute_repeats(contract$panel)
    diagnostics <- compute_observation_diagnostics(eligible, market, NULL, cfg)
    n_eligible_rows <- nrow(eligible)
    n_eligible_groups <- data.table::uniqueN(eligible$repeat_id)
    rm(eligible)
    invisible(gc())
    list(provenance = provenance, mapping_validation = mapping_validation, contract = contract,
         diagnostics = diagnostics, n_eligible_rows = n_eligible_rows, n_eligible_groups = n_eligible_groups)
  }, market_blocked = function(cond) cond)

  if (inherits(result, "market_blocked")) {
    out$status <- "blocked"
    out$reason <- conditionMessage(result)
    out$readiness$status <- "blocked"
    out$readiness$reason <- conditionMessage(result)
    out$readiness$blocked_stage <- result$stage
    out$readiness[[paste0("blocked_", result$stage)]] <- result$details
  } else {
    out$panel <- result$contract$panel
    out$ledger <- result$contract$ledger
    out$diagnostics <- result$diagnostics
    out$provenance <- result$provenance
    out$readiness$mapping_validation <- result$mapping_validation
    out$readiness$address_verification <- result$contract$address_verification
    out$readiness$geography <- result$contract$geography
    out$readiness$coverage <- result$contract$coverage
    out$readiness$date_range <- result$contract$date_range
    out$readiness$unit_evidence <- result$contract$unit_evidence
    out$readiness$n_rows_pre_band <- nrow(result$contract$panel)
    out$readiness$n_groups_pre_band <- data.table::uniqueN(result$contract$panel$repeat_id)
    out$readiness$n_rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band <- result$n_eligible_rows
    out$readiness$n_groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band <- result$n_eligible_groups
    if (market == "rentals" && identical(result$contract$unit_evidence$status, "blocked")) {
      out$status <- "blocked"
      out$reason <- paste("rental unit evidence:", result$contract$unit_evidence$reason)
      out$readiness$status <- "blocked"
      out$readiness$reason <- out$reason
      out$readiness$blocked_stage <- "rental_units"
      out$panel <- NULL
    }
  }
  gc_info <- gc()
  out$readiness$runtime_seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), started, units = "secs"))
  # Ncells are 56 bytes and Vcells 8 bytes; "max used" is since the gc(reset = TRUE) above.
  out$readiness$peak_memory_mb <- as.numeric(gc_info["Ncells", "max used"] * 56 + gc_info["Vcells", "max used"] * 8) / 1024^2
  out
}
```

```{r}
#| label: fixture-checks
#| include: false

assert_true <- function(condition, message) {
  if (!isTRUE(condition)) stop(message, call. = FALSE)
}

assert_error_matching <- function(expr, pattern, message) {
  err <- tryCatch({ force(expr); NULL }, error = identity)
  assert_true(
    inherits(err, "error") && grepl(pattern, conditionMessage(err)),
    paste0(message, if (inherits(err, "error")) paste0("\nGot error: ", conditionMessage(err)) else "\nNo error was raised.")
  )
  invisible(err)
}

run_fixture_checks <- function(checks) {
  rows <- list()
  for (unit in names(checks)) {
    for (scenario in names(checks[[unit]])) {
      outcome <- tryCatch(
        { checks[[unit]][[scenario]](); list(passed = TRUE, message = "") },
        error = function(e) list(passed = FALSE, message = conditionMessage(e))
      )
      rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- tibble::tibble(unit = unit, scenario = scenario,
                                                  passed = outcome$passed, message = outcome$message)
    }
  }
  results <- dplyr::bind_rows(rows)
  failed <- results[!results$passed, ]
  if (nrow(failed) > 0L) {
    stop("Fixture checks failed:\n", paste(sprintf("  %s / %s: %s", failed$unit, failed$scenario, failed$message),
                                            collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
  }
  results
}

# Properties: A repeat (2015, 2018); B same-month repeat (Mar 2016); C three obs,
# last with missing country; D single; E one obs outside the window (AE1); F contradictory

fixture_sales_history <- function() {
  data.table::data.table(
    house_id = sprintf("h%02d", 1:16),

    street = c("HIGH ST", "HIGH ST", "HIGH ST", "HIGH ST", "MILL LANE", "MILL LANE", "MILL LANE",
               "MILL LANE", "RIVER ROAD", "RIVER ROAD", "RIVER ROAD", "RIVER ROAD",
               "CHURCH WAY", "CHURCH WAY", "CHURCH WAY", "CHURCH WAY"),
    date_of_transfer = as.Date(c(
      "2015-02-01", "2018-06-01", "2016-03-02", "2016-03-20", "2015-05-05", "2017-07-07", "2018-08-08",
      "2017-01-01", "2014-01-01", "2016-06-06", "2015-09-09", "2018-09-09", "2015-10-10", "2017-10-10",

              600000, 620000, 700000, 720000, 0, 820000),
    property_type = c("T", "T", "F", "F", "D", "D", "D", "S", "T", "T", "T", "T", "S", "S", "D", "D"),
    old_new = "N", duration = "F",
    country = c(rep("England", 6), NA, rep("England", 4), "Wales", rep("England", 4)),

    lsoa = c(rep("E01000001", 10), "E01000010", "E01000099", NA, "E01000020", "E01000030", "E01000030"),
    msoa = "E02000001",
    quality = 1L
  )
}

fixture_mapping_from_history <- function(history, cfg, exclude_ids = character()) {
  keyed <- history[!house_id %chin% exclude_ids]
  key <- build_address_key(keyed, repeat_key_config(cfg))
  keyed <- keyed[!is.na(key)]
  key <- key[!is.na(key)]
  mapping <- data.table::data.table(house_id = keyed$house_id, repeat_id = hash_serialized_values(key))
  mapping[, repeat_count := as.integer(.N), by = repeat_id]
  mapping[]
}

fixture_manifest <- function(history, mapping, excluded_count, same_day_count) {
  list(
    repeat_manifest_version = "1", input_row_count = as.character(nrow(history)),
    mapped_count = as.character(nrow(mapping)), excluded_count = as.character(excluded_count),
    same_day_excluded_count = as.character(same_day_count), run_timestamp = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    input_mtime = "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", largest_group_size = "3"
  )
}

FIXTURE_CHECKS <- list()
FIXTURE_CHECKS$u1 <- list(

  ae1_one_date_after_restriction_drops = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    panel <- contract$panel
    assert_true(!"h09" %in% panel$id, "h09 (2014) must be outside the requested window")
    assert_true("h10" %in% panel$id, "h10 survives the common requirements before the repeat recount")
    eligible <- recompute_repeats(panel)
    assert_true(!"h10" %in% eligible$id, "AE1: property E keeps one distinct date and must drop from the repeat panel")
    assert_true(all(c("h01", "h02") %in% eligible$id), "property A remains a repeat")
    assert_true(all(c("h03", "h04") %in% eligible$id), "two dates within one calendar month meet the repeat criterion")
    assert_true(!"h08" %in% eligible$id, "window single D drops at the repeat recount")
    # C loses its missing-country row but keeps two dates; G and H lose one row and drop.
    assert_true(all(c("h05", "h06") %in% eligible$id) && !"h07" %in% eligible$id, "C keeps two England dates")
    assert_true(!any(c("h13", "h14", "h15", "h16") %in% eligible$id), "G and H retain one date each and drop")
    assert_ledger_identity(contract$ledger)
    TRUE
  },

  ledger_chains_and_names_steps = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    ledger <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)$ledger
    expected <- c("requested_dates", "mapped_rows", "address_key_verification", "geography_contradictions",
                  "finite_positive_outcome", "england", "projected_coordinates", "lsoa_msoa_nonmissing")
    assert_true(identical(ledger$step, expected), "ledger steps follow the plan order")
    assert_true(ledger$n_rows_before[[1]] == nrow(history), "first ledger row starts from the full history")
    assert_true(ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "requested_dates"] == 1, "one row outside the window")
    assert_true(ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "geography_contradictions"] == 2, "F's two rows leave as a group")
    assert_true(ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "finite_positive_outcome"] == 1, "one nonpositive price")
    assert_true(ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "england"] == 1, "one missing-country row remains after F left")
    assert_true(ledger$n_rows_removed[ledger$step == "lsoa_msoa_nonmissing"] == 1, "one missing LSOA")
    assert_ledger_identity(ledger)
    assert_true(all(ledger$market == "sales") && identical(ledger$step_order, seq_len(nrow(ledger))), "ledger keys")
    TRUE
  },

  mapping_duplicate_id_fails_without_multiplying = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    manifest <- fixture_manifest(history, mapping, 0, 0)
    n_before <- nrow(history)
    duplicated_mapping <- rbind(mapping, mapping[house_id == "h01"])
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      validate_mapping(history, duplicated_mapping, manifest, character(), "sales", cfg),
      "duplicated transaction ids", "duplicated mapping id must fail validation"
    )
    assert_true(identical(err$details$n_duplicated_mapping_ids, 1L), "duplicate count is reported")
    assert_true(nrow(history) == n_before, "history rows are untouched")
    # A clean mapping passes and the candidate count equals the history count (no multiplication).
    ok <- validate_mapping(history, mapping, manifest, character(), "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(ok$status == "passed" && ok$n_history == n_before, "clean mapping validates")
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(contract$ledger$n_rows_after[[2]] == n_before - 1, "mapped rows equal window rows: no multiplication or silent drop")
    TRUE
  },

  mapping_id_absent_from_history_fails = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    extra <- rbind(mapping, data.table::data.table(house_id = "h99", repeat_id = mapping$repeat_id[[1]], repeat_count = 1L))
    manifest <- fixture_manifest(history, extra, 0, 0)
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      validate_mapping(history, extra, manifest, character(), "sales", cfg),
      "absent from history", "mapping id absent from history must fail"
    )
    assert_true(identical(err$details$n_mapping_absent_from_history, 1L), "absent count is reported")
    TRUE
  },

  stale_repeat_id_after_address_correction = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    corrected <- data.table::copy(history)
    corrected[house_id == "h02", street := "HIGH STREET"]   # id unchanged, key changes
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      verify_current_address_keys(corrected, mapping, "sales", cfg),
      "mismatched repeat ids", "a corrected address must be caught as a stale mapping"
    )
    assert_true(identical(err$details$n_mismatched, 1L) && identical(err$details$n_missing_keys, 0L),
                "exactly one mismatched row, no missing keys")
    assert_true(identical(err$details$example_mismatched_ids, "h02"), "the corrected id is named")
    # The mapping object is untouched (read-only verification, no rebuild).
    assert_true(identical(mapping, fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)), "mapping was not rebuilt")
    # The uncorrected history passes.
    ok <- verify_current_address_keys(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(ok$status == "passed" && ok$n_mismatched == 0L && ok$n_candidates == nrow(history), "unchanged history verifies")
    TRUE
  },

  stale_repeat_id_on_mapped_singleton = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    corrected <- data.table::copy(history)
    corrected[house_id == "h08", paon := "4A"]   # D is a mapped single
    err <- assert_error_matching(
      verify_current_address_keys(corrected, mapping, "sales", cfg),
      "mismatched repeat ids", "a corrected singleton must be caught"
    )
    assert_true(identical(err$details$example_mismatched_ids, "h08"), "the singleton id is named")
    assert_true(err$details$n_window_singles >= 1L, "singles are counted among candidates")
    # A missing current key (blank postcode) is also a failure.
    blank <- data.table::copy(history)
    blank[house_id == "h05", postcode := ""]
    err2 <- assert_error_matching(
      verify_current_address_keys(blank, mapping, "sales", cfg),
      "missing current keys", "a missing current key must be caught"
    )
    assert_true(identical(err2$details$n_missing_keys, 1L), "one missing key")
    # The contract stops at the verification step, before any row-level restriction.
    assert_error_matching(
      apply_sample_contract(corrected, mapping, "sales", cfg),
      "address_keys", "the sample contract blocks the market on a stale mapping"
    )
    TRUE
  },

  geography_contradiction_detected_before_row_restriction = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    history[, repeat_id := mapping$repeat_id[match(house_id, mapping$house_id)]]
    geo <- check_group_geography_contradictions(history)
    f_id <- history[house_id == "h11", repeat_id]
    g_id <- history[house_id == "h13", repeat_id]
    assert_true(identical(geo$group_ids, f_id), "only F is contradictory (distinct nonmissing LSOA and country)")
    assert_true(geo$n_groups_lsoa == 1L && geo$n_groups_country == 1L && geo$n_groups_coordinates == 0L && geo$n_groups_msoa == 0L,
                "contradiction types are counted")
    assert_true(!g_id %in% geo$group_ids, "missing-to-observed LSOA is not a contradiction")
    history[, repeat_id := NULL]
    contract <- apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(!any(c("h11", "h12") %in% contract$panel$id), "F leaves as a whole group")
    assert_true("h14" %in% contract$panel$id, "G's observed row survives the LSOA step")
    # Had the England step run first, h12 would have gone and F would look consistent.
    england_first <- history[country == "England"]
    england_first[, repeat_id := mapping$repeat_id[match(house_id, mapping$house_id)]]
    assert_true(length(check_group_geography_contradictions(england_first)$group_ids) == 0L,
                "the England row restriction would have hidden the contradiction")
    TRUE
  },

  same_day_and_unkeyed_reconcile_with_manifest = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    # Add an unkeyed row (blank postcode) and a same-day conflict pair at a new address.
    extra <- history[house_id %in% c("h01", "h03", "h04")]
    extra[, house_id := c("h90", "h91", "h92")]
    extra[house_id == "h90", postcode := ""]
    extra[house_id %in% c("h91", "h92"), `:=`(postcode = "AB1 2CZ", paon = "9", saon = NA_character_,
                                              date_of_transfer = as.Date("2017-03-03"))]
    history <- rbind(history, extra)
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg, exclude_ids = c("h90", "h91", "h92"))
    manifest <- fixture_manifest(history, mapping, excluded_count = 1, same_day_count = 2)
    ok <- validate_mapping(history, mapping, manifest, c("h91", "h92"), "sales", cfg)
    assert_true(ok$reconciled && ok$n_history_absent_from_mapping == 3L && ok$n_unkeyed_recomputed == 1L &&
                  ok$n_same_day_recomputed == 2L, "absent rows reconcile as unkeyed + same-day")
    # Wrong manifest count.
    bad_manifest <- fixture_manifest(history, mapping, excluded_count = 2, same_day_count = 2)
    assert_error_matching(validate_mapping(history, mapping, bad_manifest, c("h91", "h92"), "sales", cfg),
                          "do not reconcile", "a manifest count mismatch fails")
    # Same-day review naming a row that is in the mapping.
    assert_error_matching(validate_mapping(history, mapping, manifest, c("h91", "h01"), "sales", cfg),
                          "do not reconcile", "a same-day id present in the mapping fails")
    # Manifest row count disagreement with the history.
    short_manifest <- manifest
    short_manifest$input_row_count <- "5"
    assert_error_matching(validate_mapping(history, mapping, short_manifest, c("h91", "h92"), "sales", cfg),
                          "input_row_count", "manifest input_row_count must equal history rows")
    TRUE
  },

  unreadable_input_and_missing_year_are_named = function() {
    missing_path <- file.path(tempdir(), "no-such-history-2026.parquet")
    err <- assert_error_matching(load_history("sales", path = missing_path),
                                 "no-such-history-2026", "an unreadable input names the file")
    assert_true(inherits(err, "market_blocked") && err$stage == "input", "unreadable input blocks the market")
    assert_error_matching(capture_input_provenance("x", missing_path, "a"), "unreadable", "provenance refuses an unreadable file")
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg(end = "2019-12-31")
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    err2 <- assert_error_matching(apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg),
                                  "2019", "a requested year without observations is named")
    assert_true(grepl("synthetic-sales-history", conditionMessage(err2)), "the history file is named")
    assert_true(inherits(err2, "market_blocked") && err2$stage == "coverage", "coverage failure blocks the market")
    TRUE
  },

  change_flags_ignore_missing_to_observed = function() {
    panel <- data.table::data.table(
      repeat_id = c("a", "a", "b", "b", "c", "c"),
      property_type = c("T", "T", "F", "S", NA, "D"),
      bedrooms = c(2, NA, 3, 3, 1, 2)
    )
    flags <- freeze_change_flags(panel, c("property_type", "bedrooms"))
    assert_true(identical(flags[repeat_id == "a", any_change], FALSE), "missing-to-observed is not a change")
    assert_true(identical(flags[repeat_id == "b", change_property_type], TRUE) && identical(flags[repeat_id == "b", change_bedrooms], FALSE),
                "two distinct observed types flag the type only")
    assert_true(identical(flags[repeat_id == "c", change_property_type], FALSE) && identical(flags[repeat_id == "c", change_bedrooms], TRUE),
                "NA-to-D is not a type change; 1-to-2 is a bedroom change")
    TRUE
  },

  rental_unit_evidence_flags_conversion_break = function() {
    dates <- as.Date(c(rep("2022-06-01", 50), rep("2023-06-01", 50)))
    ids <- rep(sprintf("p%02d", 1:50), 2)
    steady <- rental_unit_evidence(rep(c(200, 210), each = 50), dates, ids)
    assert_true(steady$status == "consistent_within_property_comparable", "a 5% shift is not a unit break")
    broken <- rental_unit_evidence(c(rep(200, 50), rep(200 * 52 / 12, 50)), dates, ids)
    assert_true(broken$status == "blocked" && abs(broken$median_ratio_2023_2022 - 52 / 12) < 1e-9,
                "a weekly-to-monthly jump is flagged")
    TRUE
  },

  diagnostics_run_with_and_without_grouping = function() {
    cfg <- fixture_sales_cfg()
    history <- fixture_sales_history()
    mapping <- fixture_mapping_from_history(history, cfg)
    panel <- recompute_repeats(apply_sample_contract(history, mapping, "sales", cfg)$panel)
    d <- compute_observation_diagnostics(panel, "sales", NULL, cfg)
    assert_true(d$n_groups == 3L && d$n_rows == 6L, "diagnostics see the eligible pre-band panel (A, B, C)")
    assert_true(d$same_month$n_same_month_pairs == 1L, "B is the single same-month pair")
    assert_true(d$extreme_ratio_total$n_pairs == 3L, "three consecutive pairs")
    panel[, band := data.table::fifelse(repeat_id == panel$repeat_id[[1]], "near", "far")]
    dg <- compute_observation_diagnostics(panel, "sales", "band", cfg)
    assert_true(all(c("near", "far") %in% dg$outcome_by_year$band), "grouping column is honoured")
    TRUE
  }
```

```{r}
#| label: estimate-inputs
#| include: false
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate

# Readiness pass (U1). Later units fold this loop into the `estimate` chunk so
# that each market's panel is used for exposure and fitting and then released.
readiness <- list()
observation_diagnostics <- list()
exclusion_ledger <- new_ledger()
input_provenance <- tibble::tibble()
market_panels <- list()
for (market in MARKETS) {
  prepared <- prepare_market_panel(market)
  readiness[[market]] <- prepared$readiness
  observation_diagnostics[[market]] <- prepared$diagnostics
  exclusion_ledger <- dplyr::bind_rows(exclusion_ledger, prepared$ledger)
  input_provenance <- dplyr::bind_rows(input_provenance, prepared$provenance)
  market_panels[[market]] <- prepared$panel
  rm(prepared)
  invisible(gc())
}
assert_ledger_identity(exclusion_ledger)
```

## Data readiness

The inputs are the two long-run transaction histories and their repeat mappings.
Every number below is computed at render time from those files; none is typed in.
A market is marked *blocked* when a validation step fails, and its model cells
are then reported as blocked rather than estimated on a substituted sample.

```{r}
#| label: readiness-status
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

status_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  r <- readiness[[m]]
  tibble::tibble(
    market = m, status = r$status,
    blocked_stage = r$blocked_stage %||% NA_character_,
    reason = r$reason %||% NA_character_,
    rows_pre_band = r$n_rows_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
    groups_pre_band = r$n_groups_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
    rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band = r$n_rows_repeat_eligible_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
    groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band = r$n_groups_repeat_eligible_pre_band %||% NA_real_,
    runtime_seconds = round(r$runtime_seconds, 1), peak_memory_mb = round(r$peak_memory_mb)
  )
}))
knitr::kable(status_rows, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Market readiness after the pre-band sample contract")
```

### Input provenance

```{r}
#| label: readiness-provenance
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate

knitr::kable(
  dplyr::mutate(input_provenance, path = sub(paste0("^", here::here(), "/"), "", path)),
  format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),

)
```

### Mapping validation

```{r}
#| label: readiness-mapping
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

mapping_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  v <- readiness[[m]]$mapping_validation
  if (is.null(v)) return(tibble::tibble(market = m, status = readiness[[m]]$status))
  tibble::tibble(
    market = m, status = v$status, history_rows = v$n_history, mapping_rows = v$n_mapping,
    mapping_groups = v$n_groups_mapping,
    mapping_ids_absent_from_history = v$n_mapping_absent_from_history,
    history_rows_absent_from_mapping = v$n_history_absent_from_mapping,
    unkeyed_manifest = v$n_unkeyed_manifest, unkeyed_recomputed = v$n_unkeyed_recomputed,
    same_day_manifest = v$n_same_day_manifest, same_day_review_ids = v$n_same_day_review,
    reconciled = v$reconciled, generation_id = v$generation_id
  )
}))
knitr::kable(mapping_rows, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Mapping integrity: unique string ids, one-to-one join, and reconciliation of rows absent from the mapping against the manifest and the same-day review")
```

### Current-address verification

Address keys and expected repeat ids are recomputed read-only on every
requested-window row that is in the mapping, singles included, with the
production `build_address_key()` and `hash_serialized_values()` contract and the
market's exact field order. Any missing current key or mismatched repeat id
blocks the market; nothing is rebuilt or repaired here.

```{r}
#| label: readiness-address
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

address_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  a <- readiness[[m]]$address_verification %||% readiness[[m]]$blocked_address_keys
  if (is.null(a)) return(tibble::tibble(market = m, status = readiness[[m]]$status))
  tibble::tibble(
    market = m, status = a$status, candidates = a$n_candidates, candidate_groups = a$n_candidate_groups,
    window_singles = a$n_window_singles, missing_current_keys = a$n_missing_keys,
    mismatched_repeat_ids = a$n_mismatched, mismatched_groups = a$n_mismatched_groups
  )
}))
knitr::kable(address_rows, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "KTD10 current-address verification on requested-window mapped candidates")

geography_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) {
  g <- readiness[[m]]$geography
  if (is.null(g)) return(tibble::tibble(market = m))
  tibble::tibble(market = m, groups_checked = g$n_groups_checked, rows_checked = g$n_rows_checked,
                 contradictory_groups = g$n_groups_contradictory, country = g$n_groups_country,
                 coordinates = g$n_groups_coordinates, lsoa = g$n_groups_lsoa, msoa = g$n_groups_msoa)
}))
knitr::kable(geography_rows, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Contradictory nonmissing geography within candidate repeat groups (whole groups excluded)")
```

### Rental price units

```{r}
#| label: readiness-rental-units
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

u <- readiness$rentals$unit_evidence
if (!is.null(u)) {
  unit_rows <- tibble::tibble(
    item = c("Documented unit", "Vintage proxy", "Conversion applied", "Status",
             "2023/2022 median ratio", "2023/2022 within-property ratio (properties listed in both years)",
             "Weekly-to-monthly factor and tolerance band", "Reason"),
    value = c(u$documented_unit, u$vintage_proxy, u$conversion_applied, u$status,
              sprintf("%.4f", u$median_ratio_2023_2022),
              sprintf("%.4f (n = %s)", u$within_property_ratio_2023_2022, format_count(u$n_within_property_pairs)),
              sprintf("%.3f, flagged if the ratio lies within a factor of %.2f of it or its inverse", u$weekly_monthly_factor, u$tolerance),
              ifelse(is.na(u$reason), "A constant unit is absorbed by property and calendar-month effects; no conversion is applied.", u$reason))
  )
  emit_table(knitr::kable(unit_rows, format = "html", caption = "Rental unit evidence"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(u$by_year, format = "html", digits = 2, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                   caption = "listing_price by listing year (finite positive prices, requested window, mapped candidates)"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(u$by_month, format = "html", digits = 2, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                   caption = "listing_price by month around the 2022/2023 vintage boundary"))
} else {
  cat("Rental unit evidence unavailable: ", readiness$rentals$reason, "\n")
}
```

### Exclusion ledger

Each row is one restriction in the plan's order; consecutive rows chain exactly.
The distance-band restriction and the two-distinct-dates requirement follow in
the exposure section.

```{r}
#| label: readiness-ledger
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

knitr::kable(exclusion_ledger, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             caption = "Exclusion ledger through the common requirements (pre-band)")

coverage_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(MARKETS, function(m) readiness[[m]]$coverage))
if (nrow(coverage_rows) > 0L) {
  coverage_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(coverage_rows, names_from = market, values_from = n_rows)
  emit_table(knitr::kable(coverage_wide, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                          caption = "Requested-window history rows by year"))
}
```

### Observation diagnostics

Descriptive only: no diagnostic introduces an exclusion. Computed on the pre-band
panel restricted to properties with at least two distinct dates; the exposure
section repeats them by distance band.

```{r}
#| label: readiness-diagnostics
#| eval: !expr params$reestimate
#| results: asis

for (m in MARKETS) {
  d <- observation_diagnostics[[m]]
  if (is.null(d)) { cat("\n\n", m, ": diagnostics unavailable (", readiness[[m]]$reason, ")\n\n", sep = ""); next }
  cat("\n\n#### ", tools::toTitleCase(m), "\n\n", sep = "")
  spatial <- d$spatial
  headline <- tibble::tibble(
    item = c("Rows", "Repeat properties", "Groups with more than 12 observations",
             "Unique coordinates", "Unique postcodes", "Geography labels", "Postcode lookup (stated cleaning vintage)"),
    value = c(format_count(d$n_rows), format_count(d$n_groups), format_count(d$n_large_groups),
              format_count(spatial$n_unique_coordinates), format_count(spatial$n_unique_postcodes),
              spatial$geography_vintage,
              sprintf("%s (%s)", sub(paste0("^", here::here(), "/"), "", spatial$postcode_lookup_path),
                      ifelse(spatial$postcode_lookup_exists, "present", "absent")))
  )
  emit_table(knitr::kable(headline, format = "html", caption = paste(tools::toTitleCase(m), "panel summary")))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(d$group_sizes, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Observations per repeat group"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(d$gap_summary, format = "html", digits = 3, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Inter-observation gaps (days) between consecutive observations"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(d$same_month, format = "html", digits = 4, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Same-month consecutive repeats"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(d$outcome_by_year, format = "html", digits = 3, format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Log outcome by year"))
  emit_table(knitr::kable(d$extreme_ratio_by_year, format = "html", digits = 4, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                   caption = sprintf("Consecutive pairs with annualised price ratio above %s or below 1/%s, by year of the later observation",
                                     CONFIG$extreme_annualized_price_ratio, CONFIG$extreme_annualized_price_ratio)))
  if (!is.null(d$rented_fallback_by_year)) {
    emit_table(knitr::kable(d$rented_fallback_by_year, format = "html", digits = 4, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
                     caption = "rented_est fallback share by year (rented missing, latest_to_rent used)"))
  }
  emit_table(knitr::kable(spatial$quality_distribution, format = "html", format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Coordinate quality (ONS gridind)"))
}
```

## Provenance and reproduce

```{r}
#| label: fixture-summary
#| results: asis

knitr::kable(fixture_results[, c("unit", "scenario", "passed")], format = "html",
             caption = "Fixture checks run at render time (synthetic data)")
```

From the project root, using the R 4.6.0 `rv` environment:

```bash
quarto render docs/reports/2026-09-19-001-long-run-public-attention-repeat-properties.qmd --to html
```

To rebuild the presentation from the saved bundle without re-estimation:

```bash
quarto render docs/reports/2026-09-19-001-long-run-public-attention-repeat-properties.qmd --to html -P reestimate:false
```
